cycle_frequency_note: About 5 million heavy truck axle crossings per year on a moderately trafficked interstate bridge deck.
inspection_interval_note: FHWA National Bridge Inspection Standards require routine inspection at most every 24 months.

impact.source: FHWA National Bridge Inventory, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/bridge/nbi.cfm and ASCE 2021 Infrastructure Report Card.

Concrete_normal.name: Normal strength reinforced concrete deck, f_c 35 MPa
Concrete_normal.K_IC_note: Derived from K_IC = sqrt(E * G_f) with E = 30 GPa and G_f = 100 J/m^2.
Concrete_normal.paris_units: da/dN in m/cycle, delta_K in MPa*sqrt(m)
Concrete_normal.paris_note: Representative fit. Literature scatter for concrete fatigue crack growth is very wide, reported m spans roughly 3 to 12.
sources: Bazant and Pfeiffer 1987, ACI Materials Journal, determination of fracture energy from size effect
Bazant and Planas 1998, Fracture and Size Effect in Concrete and Other Quasibrittle Materials

Rebar_A615_Gr60.name: Deformed carbon steel reinforcing bar, ASTM A615 Grade 60
sources: BS 7910 and ASTM A615 property tables for ferritic steel in air
